# BB00625: Letter to Mulla 'Abdu'l-Karim Qazvini {.unnumbered}

God is Most Great with a great greatness

O Generous One! We have bestowed upon thee one from the Truth and the First One, that thou mayest preserve all that hath been sent down from God, and that thou mayest deliver it unto the Name of the Unity, and that thou mayest inquire of him who writeth the verses of God that which ye know not to be the purpose of God.
